title: Create package

steps.folderDescription: Choose the folder containing the unpacked mod files to pack.
steps.outputDescription: Choose where the package will be written, as .pak or .zip.

bottomBar.idle: Select an input folder and an output file to create the package

exportModal.title: Export translation
exportModal.description: Choose the format and review the export settings.

exportLanguageTip: Pick the localization folder that matches the language you play with. The game replaces strings by UUID inside Localization/{language}/ — if your language is not supported by the game, keep English (unsupported languages fall back to it). Files exported as .loca are named after this language (e.g. english.loca).
